description: Dedicated Sport Pages (Sport Hub Architecture) — Create sport-level destination pages (Basketball, Football, etc.) with league sub-tabs (NBA, NCAAB, WNBA) and Futures placeholder, navigable from Search and Games tabs

userStories.title: Create SportCategory enum and league metadata
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a centralized sport category enum that groups leagues under sports, providing display names, icons, and league lists so sport pages can be configured from a single source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Booki/Models/SportCategory.swift with enum SportCategory: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable
Cases: basketball, football, baseball, hockey, soccer (no golf yet)
Computed property displayName: 'Basketball', 'Football', 'Baseball', 'Hockey', 'Soccer'
Computed property iconName: SF Symbol string (basketball.fill, football.fill, etc.)
Computed property leagues: [LeagueInfo] where LeagueInfo is a struct with id, displayName (e.g. 'NBA'), and matchesEvent closure that checks Event.sport and Event.league
Basketball leagues: NBA, NCAAB, WNBA. Football leagues: NFL, NCAAF. Baseball: MLB. Hockey: NHL. Soccer: EPL, MLS
Static func fromEvent(_ event: Event) -> SportCategory? that matches an Event to its category
Static var popular: [SportCategory] returning [.basketball, .football, .baseball, .hockey] for Search tab
Add file to Xcode pbxproj (PBXBuildFile, PBXFileReference, group children, Sources build phase)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: LeagueInfo needs to match on Event.sport AND Event.league strings. Use the existing string values from OddsAPIMapper: sport='Basketball' league='NBA', sport='Football' league='NFL', etc. Keep existing sportIconName() function in GamesView — don't remove yet.

userStories.title: Create SportPageView with league sub-tabs and Games content
userStories.description: As a player, I want to navigate to a sport page (e.g. Basketball) that has league tabs (NBA, NCAAB, WNBA) showing filtered games for each league.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Booki/Views/SportPageView.swift
Init takes SportCategory parameter and optional isViewOnly: Bool = false
Navigation title shows category displayName (e.g. 'Basketball')
Top-level segmented Picker: league tabs derived from category.leagues, plus a 'Futures' tab at the end
When a league tab is selected, show events filtered to that league using CompactGameRow
Group events by date with sticky section headers, same pattern as GamesView
Only show bettable events (future start time, not locked/final/canceled) unless isViewOnly
Wire up bet slip selection when isViewOnly is false — pass through onSelectOdds and selections from BetSlipState environment
If isViewOnly is true, pass isViewOnly to CompactGameRow (muted odds, no tap)
Default selected tab to first league
Add file to Xcode pbxproj
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reuse event filtering and grouping patterns from GamesView. Use @Environment(BetSlipState.self) for bet slip. Use @Query for events. Theme.background for page background. If a league has no events, show a simple empty state ('No games available').

userStories.title: Add Futures placeholder tab to SportPageView
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see a Futures tab on the sport page that shows a coming soon placeholder, establishing the architecture for future expansion.
acceptanceCriteria: When 'Futures' is selected in the segmented control, show a centered placeholder view
Placeholder shows: 'Futures Coming Soon' as title (Theme.headline, Theme.textPrimary)
Subtitle: 'Season-long and tournament markets will appear here.' (Theme.bodyFont, Theme.textSecondary)
Use a relevant SF Symbol icon above the title (e.g. 'chart.line.uptrend.xyaxis') in Theme.textMuted at 48pt
Placeholder is vertically centered in the available space
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Keep this simple — just a static placeholder. No dynamic data needed.

userStories.title: Add Popular Sports section to SearchView
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see a 'Popular Sports' section in the Search tab when no search query is active, so I can quickly navigate to a sport page.
acceptanceCriteria: When searchText is empty, show a 'POPULAR SPORTS' section header (Theme.caption, tracking 1.0, Theme.textSecondary)
List SportCategory.popular as tappable rows
Each row shows: sport icon (SF Symbol) + sport displayName + chevron.right
Row styling: Theme.textPrimary for name, Theme.accent for icon, Theme.cardBackground background with rounded corners
Tapping a row navigates to SportPageView(category: sportCategory) via NavigationLink
Popular Sports section disappears when user starts typing (search results take over)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: SearchView is in Booki/Views/SearchView.swift. It already has NavigationStack context. Use existing styling patterns (Theme.cardBackground cards, section headers with tracking).

userStories.title: Make Games tab sport headers tappable with navigation to sport page
userStories.description: As a player, I want to tap a sport section header on the Games tab to navigate to that sport's dedicated page.
acceptanceCriteria: Sport-level sticky headers in GamesView become tappable NavigationLinks
Add a chevron.right indicator to the trailing side of each sport header
Tapping navigates to SportPageView for the matching SportCategory
Only add navigation if SportCategory.fromEvent returns a valid category for events in that sport group
If no matching SportCategory, header remains non-tappable (no chevron)
Preserve existing header styling (icon, sport name, league name)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: GamesView is in Booki/Views/GamesView.swift. Headers are rendered in LazyVStack with pinned section headers. The view is inside a NavigationStack. The outer grouping is by sport — tapping 'Basketball' header navigates to the Basketball sport page.

userStories.title: Make bookie EventsListView sport headers tappable
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to tap sport headers on the Events tab to navigate to the sport page in view-only mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Sport-level sticky headers in EventsListView become tappable NavigationLinks
Add chevron.right indicator matching GamesView pattern from US-005
Navigate to SportPageView with isViewOnly: true
Only add navigation if SportCategory match exists
Preserve existing header styling
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: EventsListView is in Booki/Views/EventsListView.swift. Similar architecture to GamesView.

userStories.title: Refactor GamesView and EventsListView to use SportCategory for icons
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to replace the inline sportIconName() functions with SportCategory lookups to consolidate sport metadata in one place.
acceptanceCriteria: GamesView.sportIconName(for:) replaced with SportCategory-based lookup
EventsListView sport icon logic replaced similarly
SportTabButton and sport headers use SportCategory for icon resolution
Fallback to 'sportscourt' SF Symbol if no SportCategory match (same behavior as before)
Remove the standalone sportIconName() function from GamesView after migration
All existing sport tabs and headers render identically to before
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is a refactor — output should be visually identical. The sportIconName function is at the bottom of GamesView.swift around line 620.
